description: Add Manual Supermarket View page with editable Bedrock prompts and parameters for experimenting with sort results
steps: Add POST /sort-ingredients-manual API route to apps/api/src/handler.ts that accepts systemPrompt, userPrompt, temperature, maxTokens, ingredients, and aisles and returns groups + rawResponse
Add /sort-ingredients-manual API Gateway resource in CDK stack
Add route for recipes/:id/shop-manual in app.routes.ts
Add Manual Mode link to supermarket-view.component.ts
Add translation keys to en.json and de.json
acceptance_criteria: POST /sort-ingredients-manual API route accepts custom prompts and Bedrock parameters
API returns both sorted groups and raw Bedrock response text
Manual view component has editable textareas for system and user prompts
Manual view has temperature and max tokens inputs
Execute button calls the manual endpoint with custom values
Results show sorted groups and raw response
Regular shopping view has a link to Manual Mode
All i18n keys added for both en.json and de.json
npx nx run-many -t build lint passes cleanly
verification: Run: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npx nx run-many -t build lint
